post:

While the figures themselves are the same, the packaging features the French title La Guerre des Étoiles, a blocky Meccano logo, and translated character names like Yan Solo and Dark Vador! 🇫🇷

Would you want these unique pieces in your collection?

headline: Jocasta debuts in VisionQuest with dark twist
post:
Hey Marvel fans! The Disney+ series "VisionQuest" is shaking things up with some massive new additions to the MCU. According to Screen Rant, episodes 3 and 4 officially introduce the 1977 Marvel Comics character Jocasta, played by T'Nia Miller. In the show, she was once Doctor Josephine Carrington, but she arrived on screen as a mysterious hooded figure known as the Butcherbird Killer.

Things take a seriously dark turn by the end of episode 4. James Spader's Ultron—who is currently controlling Paul Bettany's Vision's body—tricks Jocasta into vaporizing the last scientist. While Vision was trying to avoid hurting anyone, Ultron took the wheel and executed a much more ruthless plan.

Meanwhile, Todd Stashwick's mercenary Paladin had his backstory explored, revealing ties to the Ten Rings syndicate and past encounters with Charlie Cox's Daredevil off-screen. Plus, Bruce Banner is reportedly unavailable during these events, mirroring what's happening around the same time in "Spider-Man: Brand New Day". 

Are you keeping up with all the AI drama on "VisionQuest"? 

#VisionQuest #Marvel #Jocasta
original_title: The MCU Officially Debuts 49-Year Marvel Comics Character With A Dark Twist

headline: Keanu Reeves in talks for Wan film
post:
Keanu Reeves is reportedly in discussions to join Paramount’s remake of the crime thriller The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil. James Wan is attached to direct the project, which follows a police detective and a gangster pursuing the same killer.

Additional drafts of the screenplay were written by Shay Hatten and Brian Helgeland, with a script also penned by Pearson. Production is reportedly set to begin in April 2027.

Further updates will follow as more information becomes available.

#KeanuReeves #JamesWan #TheGangsterTheCopTheDevil
original_title: Keanu Reeves to Hunt Serial Killer In New James Wan Film & He’s Teaming With A MCU Star to Do It

headline: VisionQuest settles the WandaVision debate
post:
Hey Marvel family! The newest Disney+ series is tackling one of the biggest debates in the fandom head-on. According to /Film, the latest episodes of "VisionQuest" finally weigh in on the controversial actions of Wanda Maximoff in Westview.

In Episode 3, titled "Reboot," Paul Bettany's synthezoid character breaks down the past. He explains the reality of the hex to his wayward son Tommy, played by Ruaridh Mollica. During the simulation, he bluntly calls Wanda's actions "morally abhorrent." It is a direct answer to whether she was a grieving victim or a villain.

This new perspective comes from the White Vision. Since he is reconstructed from parts rather than conjured by magic, his view lacks emotional clouding. Showrunner Terry Matalas is tackling these complex character arcs directly. Do you agree with this new take on the Westview hex? 🔮

#VisionQuest #WandaVision #MarvelStudios
original_title: VisionQuest Has A Definitive Answer To WandaVision's Most Controversial Debate
